title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: One word
hook: If your team could remember one word today, what would it be?
intro: You give the team five reminders before the game.
They forget all of them by first pitch.
statement: One word is easier to carry than five reminders.
q1: Do you give the team one focus word —
q2: or a short list so nothing gets missed?
q3: Which word would help most this week?
t1: Every coach is different. But teams stay focused
t2: when the message fits in one word.
cta: Coaches — what is your team's word?
ctaPrompt: Share your team word below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
If your team could remember one word today, what would it be?
You give the team five reminders before the game. They forget all of them by first pitch.
One word is easier to carry than five reminders.
One word or a short list. Every team is different.
What is your team's word? Share your habit in the comments.
